papers.title: Pathwise Conditioning of Gaussian Processes
papers.abstract: As Gaussian processes are used to answer increasingly complex questions, analytic solutions become scarcer and scarcer. Monte Carlo methods act as a convenient bridge for connecting intractable mathematical expressions with actionable estimates via sampling. Conventional approaches for simulating Gaussian process posteriors view samples as draws from marginal distributions of process values at finite sets of input locations. This distribution-centric characterization leads to generative strategies that scale cubically in the size of the desired random vector. These methods are prohibitively expensive in cases where we would, ideally, like to draw high-dimensional vectors or even continuous sample paths. In this work, we investigate a different line of reasoning: rather than focusing on distributions, we articulate Gaussian conditionals at the level of random variables. We show how this pathwise interpretation of conditioning gives rise to a general family of approximations that lend themselves to efficiently sampling Gaussian process posteriors. Starting from first principles, we derive these methods and analyze the approximation errors they introduce. We, then, ground these results by exploring the practical implications of pathwise conditioning in various applied settings, such as global optimization and reinforcement learning.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法提高了高斯过程后验采样的效率，可迁移至代理模型中的不确定性量化与优化，但未涉及植入物生物力学具体应用。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to any FEA surrogate or biomechanical design problem, and lacks validation on constrained multi-objective optimization or uncertainty quantification for implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高斯过程后验采样在高维或连续路径时计算代价过高的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于路径条件化的随机变量解释，构造高效近似采样方法。
summary_zh.result: 得到一类通用近似族，降低采样复杂度且误差可控。
summary_zh.validation: 通过理论误差分析和全局优化、强化学习等应用实例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient sampling from Gaussian process posteriors when analytic solutions are intractable and standard methods scale cubically.
summary_en.method: A pathwise conditioning approach that reinterprets Gaussian conditioning at the random variable level to derive a family of approximations.
summary_en.result: A general family of sampling methods with reduced computational cost and controlled approximation error.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical error analysis and empirical demonstrations in global optimization and reinforcement learning settings.

papers.title: Multiscale Reduced-Order Modeling of a Titanium Skin Panel Subjected to Thermo-Mechanical Loading
papers.abstract: This manuscript presents the formulation, implementation, calibration and application of a multiscale reduced-order model to simulate a titanium panel structure subjected to thermo-mechanical loading associated with high-speed flight. The formulation is based on the eigenstrain-based reduced-order homogenization model (EHM) and further considers thermal strain as well as temperature dependent material properties and evolution laws. The material microstructure (i.e., at the scale of a polycrystalline representative volume element (RVE)) and underlying microstructural mechanisms are directly incorporated and fully coupled with a structural analysis, allowing concurrently probing the response at the structural scale and the material microscale. The proposed approach was fully calibrated using a series of uniaxial tension tests of Ti-6242S at a wide range of temperatures and two different strain rates. The calibrated model is then adopted to study the response of a generic aircraft skin panel subjected to thermo-mechanical loading associated with high-speed flight. The analysis focuses on demonstrating the capability of the model to predict not only the structural scale response, but simultaneously the microscale response, and further studies the effects of temperature and texture on the response.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文的方法可转移至生物力学领域，但未涉及不确定量化或约束处理。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for optimization, lacks uncertainty quantification, and focuses on aerospace structures rather than biomechanical implants or FEA surrogate needs.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效模拟钛合金蒙皮在热力载荷下的多尺度响应。
summary_zh.method: 基于本征应变的降阶均匀化模型，耦合温度与微观结构。
summary_zh.result: 模型同时预测结构尺度与微尺度响应，揭示温度与织构影响。
summary_zh.validation: 通过不同温度与应变率的单轴拉伸试验校准模型。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently simulate the multiscale response of a titanium skin panel under thermo-mechanical loading by developing a reduced-order model.
summary_en.method: An eigenstrain-based reduced-order homogenization model (EHM) incorporating thermal strain and temperature-dependent material properties was formulated and coupled with structural analysis.
summary_en.result: The model concurrently predicts structural-scale displacement and microscale stress/strain fields, demonstrating the effects of temperature and crystallographic texture.
summary_en.validation: The model was calibrated using uniaxial tension tests on Ti-6242S across a range of temperatures and strain rates.

papers.title: Metal 3D Printed D-Band Waveguide to Surface Wave Transition
papers.abstract: The coupling efficiency between free space waves and surface waves is low, narrowband, or both. Highly efficient broadband (better than 20% fractional bandwidth) coupling from waveguide modes can be achieved through sophisticated transitions whose fabrication can be enabled through additive manufacturing (e.g. selective laser melting). Here, we present alternative metallic transitions designed to couple the fundamental mode of a D-band waveguide to the fundamental transverse-magnetic surface mode supported by a periodic metal corrugated grating. Simulations of the coupling process and initial measurements have been undertaken.

llm.why_not_core: No biomedical implant context, no stress shielding, no mechanical testing, no osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高自由空间波与表面波之间的耦合效率。
summary_zh.method: 设计并利用金属增材制造制备D波段波导到表面波转换器。
summary_zh.result: 仿真和初步测量验证了设计的宽带高耦合性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过仿真和初始实验测量验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the coupling efficiency between free-space waves and surface waves over a broad bandwidth.
summary_en.method: Metallic transitions were designed and fabricated via selective laser melting to couple D-band waveguide mode to a surface mode on a corrugated grating.
summary_en.result: Simulations and preliminary measurements demonstrated broadband and high-efficiency coupling.
summary_en.validation: Validated through electromagnetic simulations and initial experimental measurements.
